Explains Muon mechanism via spectral analysis, but LLM-only (Transformers), lacks comparison at multiple step budgets and vision models
Muon orthogonalization adaptivity by operator type, but LLM pretraining focus, no explicit step-budget variation or CIFAR-scale testing
General LLM optimizer survey; LLM-only scope violates implicit rule against large-scale pretraining without small-model analysis
DynMuon explains how spectral shaping changes across training stages with curvature and noise, strong on mechanism; unclear if tested at multiple step budgets or vision models
Focuses on analog/hardware implementability of orthogonalization, not hyperparameter effects or vision model training

Directly compares Muon across training horizons (1×–256× overtraining factors), reports how learning rate and memory schedules reverse and change with horizon, multiple model scales; mechanism of schedule variation transfers despite larger models
